information: # Note: This competition does not feature the 3x3x3 Cube event. Welcome to Slow & Easy 2024! This will be a small competition featuring only blindfolded events. For those who are interested in joining **FMC 2024** can register through [here](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/FMC2024/register). The event will take place at the same venue immediately after the end of this competition.
